claims.quote: Endemic to India where it appears to be restricted to the southwesterly states of Karnataka and Kerala.

regions.name: Tunga
regions.quote: In the former it has been collected from close to the city of Dandeli, Uttara Kannada (North Canara) district, the Fraserpett River, Coorg district and Korkanhalla stream, a tributary of the Tunga river at an altitude of 652 m above sea level, whereas in the latter the only information available is that it occurs in Wayanad district.
